text: The future of AI is a topic that interests many people. Today, we have "narrow AI," which is good at specific tasks like translating languages or recognizing faces. However, researchers are working towards Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), a machine that can think and learn like a human. AGI could bring great benefits, such as solving serious problems in medicine and science. On the other hand, it also carries risks, like job losses or safety concerns. Experts disagree about when AGI might arrive. Some predict it will happen within twenty years, while others believe it is much further away.
